gams_procedures.notes: The pinned ddCOSMO library and original fixed-form Lebedev quadrature source are wrapped for FPM with extension-based source form and legacy external interfaces. OpenMP directives are inactive in this serial profile and OpenBLAS supplies dense linear algebra. The checked consumer adapts the author main and formaldehyde input, embedding its four-atom coordinates, radii, charges and solver settings. It compares solvation energy and all force components against the author reference output, requires finite values and checks zero net force. Full-sized dummy arrays replace the unused one-element placeholders in the example while leaving library numerical routines unchanged. D2 identifies the Jacobi/DIIS linear-system solution used by cosmo; Z denotes the physical solvation model. Other molecules, solvent parameters, quantum densities and parallel performance are outside this verification scope. LGPL notices and author reference requests remain in the source tree.

description: Charge-dependent D4 molecular dispersion energies and gradients.
source:
! DFT-D4 PBE two-body reference: test_pbed4_mb01 in the pinned upstream tests.
! MB16-43/01 geometry adapted from mstore v0.4.0 (Apache-2.0).
! SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later AND Apache-2.0
program main
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use dftd4, only: d4_model, new_d4_model, rational_damping_param, &
      get_dispersion, realspace_cutoff
   use mctc_env, only: wp, error_type
   use mctc_io, only: new, structure_type
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: nat = 16
   character(len=*), parameter :: sym(nat) = [character(len=4)::&
      & "Na", "H", "O", "H", "F", "H", "H", "O", "N", "H", "H", "Cl", "B", "B", "N", "Al"]
   real(wp), parameter :: xyz(3, nat) = reshape([&
      & -1.85528263484662_wp,  3.58670515364616_wp, -2.41763729306344_wp, &
      &  4.40178023537845_wp,  0.02338844412653_wp, -4.95457749372945_wp, &
      & -2.98706033463438_wp,  4.76252065456814_wp,  1.27043301573532_wp, &
      &  0.79980886075526_wp,  1.41103455609189_wp, -5.04655321620119_wp, &
      & -4.20647469409936_wp,  1.84275767548460_wp,  4.55038084858449_wp, &
      & -3.54356121843970_wp, -3.18835665176557_wp,  1.46240021785588_wp, &
      &  2.70032160109941_wp,  1.06818452504054_wp, -1.73234650374438_wp, &
      &  3.73114088824361_wp, -2.07001543363453_wp,  2.23160937604731_wp, &
      & -1.75306819230397_wp,  0.35951417150421_wp,  1.05323406177129_wp, &
      &  5.41755788583825_wp, -1.57881830078929_wp,  1.75394002750038_wp, &
      & -2.23462868255966_wp, -2.13856505054269_wp,  4.10922285746451_wp, &
      &  1.01565866207568_wp, -3.21952154552768_wp, -3.36050963020778_wp, &
      &  2.42119255723593_wp,  0.26626435093114_wp, -3.91862474360560_wp, &
      & -3.02526098819107_wp,  2.53667889095925_wp,  2.31664984740423_wp, &
      & -2.00438948664892_wp, -2.29235136977220_wp,  2.19782807357059_wp, &
      &  1.12226554109716_wp, -1.36942007032045_wp,  0.48455055461782_wp],&
      & shape(xyz))

   real(wp), parameter :: reference = -1.8578752883363366e-2_wp
   real(wp), parameter :: step = 1.0e-5_wp
   real(wp) :: energy, plus, minus, translated, fd_error
   real(wp) :: gradient(3,nat), scratch(3,nat), positions(3,nat)

   call evaluate(xyz, energy, gradient)
   if (abs(energy-reference) > 1.0e-10_wp) error stop 'upstream energy reference'
   if (maxval(abs(sum(gradient,dim=2))) > 1.0e-9_wp) error stop 'net force'
   positions=xyz
   positions(1,1)=positions(1,1)+step
   call evaluate(positions,plus,scratch)
   positions(1,1)=positions(1,1)-2*step
   call evaluate(positions,minus,scratch)
   fd_error=abs((plus-minus)/(2*step)-gradient(1,1))
   if (fd_error > 1.0e-6_wp) error stop 'finite-difference gradient'
   positions=xyz+1.25_wp
   call evaluate(positions,translated,scratch)
   if (abs(translated-energy) > 1.0e-11_wp) error stop 'translation invariance'
   print '(a,f20.14)', 'PBE-D4 dispersion energy (Hartree): ',energy
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Absolute reference error: ',abs(energy-reference)
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Gradient finite-difference error: ',fd_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS dftd4'
contains
   subroutine evaluate(pos,e,g)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: pos(3,nat)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: e,g(3,nat)
      type(structure_type) :: mol
      type(d4_model) :: model
      type(error_type), allocatable :: error
      type(rational_damping_param), parameter :: param=rational_damping_param( &
         s6=1.0_wp,s9=0.0_wp,alp=16.0_wp, &
         s8=0.95948085_wp,a1=0.38574991_wp,a2=4.80688534_wp)
      real(wp) :: sigma(3,3)
      call new(mol,sym,pos)
      call new_d4_model(error,model,mol)
      if (allocated(error)) then
         print '(a)',error%message
         error stop 'D4 model initialization'
      end if
      call get_dispersion(mol,model,param,realspace_cutoff(),e,g,sigma)
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(e)) error stop 'nonfinite energy'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(g))) error stop 'nonfinite gradient'
   end subroutine evaluate
end program main

gams_procedures.notes: The original FPM library and pinned mctc-lib, multicharge, Jonquil and TOML-F dependencies are compiled with GNU Fortran 16.2.0 and pinned OpenBLAS. ! Uses the unmodified serial Chapter 4 modules from modern-fortran/tsunami (MIT).
! The time-stepping equations follow src/ch04/tsunami.f90. No coarrays are used.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real32, real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use mod_diff, only: diff_centered, diff_upwind
   use mod_initial, only: set_gaussian
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=100, steps=200
   real(real32), parameter :: dt=0.02_real32, dx=1.0_real32, g=9.8_real32, depth=10.0_real32
   real(real32) :: h(n), u(n), initial(n), wave(n), expected(n), calculated(n)
   real(real32) :: pi, angle, phase
   real(real64) :: mass_initial, mass_final
   integer :: i, k, left
   pi=acos(-1.0_real32)
   phase=2*pi/real(n,real32)
   do i=1,n
      angle=phase*real(i-1,real32)
      wave(i)=sin(angle)
      expected(i)=sin(phase)*cos(angle)
   end do
   calculated=diff_centered(wave)
   if (maxval(abs(calculated-expected)) > 1.0e-6_real32) error stop 'Centered difference check'
   do i=1,n
      left=modulo(i-2,n)+1
      expected(i)=wave(i)-wave(left)
   end do
   calculated=diff_upwind(wave)
   if (maxval(abs(calculated-expected)) > 1.0e-6_real32) error stop 'Upwind difference check'
   call set_gaussian(h,25,0.02_real32)
   if (abs(h(25)-1.0_real32) > epsilon(1.0_real32)) error stop 'Gaussian peak check'
   if (maxval(abs(h(24:1:-1)-h(26:49))) > 1.0e-6_real32) error stop 'Gaussian symmetry check'
   h=0.1_real32*h
   initial=h
   u=0
   mass_initial=sum(real(h,real64))*real(dx,real64)
   do k=1,steps
      u=u-(u*diff_centered(u)+g*diff_centered(h))/dx*dt
      h=h-diff_centered(u*(depth+h))/dx*dt
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(h)) .or. .not.all(ieee_is_finite(u))) error stop 'Nonfinite solution'
   end do
   mass_final=sum(real(h,real64))*real(dx,real64)
   if (abs(mass_final-mass_initial)>1.0e-5_real64*mass_initial) error stop 'Mass conservation check'
   if (maxval(abs(h-initial))<1.0e-3_real32) error stop 'Wave did not evolve'
   if (minval(depth+h)<=0.0_real32) error stop 'Nonpositive total water depth'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Time steps: ',steps
   print '(a,2f13.8)', 'Initial and final integrated elevation: ',mass_initial,mass_final
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Absolute conservation error: ',abs(mass_final-mass_initial)
   print '(a,2f12.7)', 'Final elevation range: ',minval(h),maxval(h)
   print '(a)', 'PASS tsunami'
end program main

gams_procedures.notes: Only the author serial Chapter 4 mod_diff and mod_initial modules are wrapped; their contents are unchanged. The main follows the chapter shallow-water time-stepping equations on a 100-cell periodic grid for 200 steps. It checks the centered difference against a discrete sine derivative, the upwind difference against an independently indexed periodic reference, Gaussian peak/symmetry, finite water height/velocity, positive total depth, nontrivial evolution, and conservation of integrated elevation. The example uses REAL32, with REAL64 accumulation of mass. I2 classifies the demonstrated PDE calculation; H1 classifies diff_centered/diff_upwind as numerical differentiation. This is an educational finite-difference demonstration, not validation of a production tsunami model. Other chapters, coarrays and parallel scaling are not verified. MIT notices are retained.

! Plain Fortran serial pFUnit example: no annotation preprocessor is needed.
! This catalog configuration supports assertion ranks 0, 1 and 2.
module playground_checks
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use FUnit, only: assertEqual, assertTrue
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine scalar_checks()
      call assertEqual(4,2+2)
      call assertTrue(sqrt(2.0_real64)>1.0_real64)
      call assertEqual(2.0_real64,sqrt(2.0_real64)**2,tolerance=1.0e-12_real64)
   end subroutine scalar_checks
   subroutine vector_checks()
      real(real64) :: a(3)=[1.0_real64,2.0_real64,3.0_real64]
      call assertEqual([1.0_real64,4.0_real64,9.0_real64],a*a,tolerance=1.0e-12_real64)
   end subroutine vector_checks
   subroutine matrix_checks()
      real(real64) :: a(2,2), identity(2,2)
      a=reshape([1.0_real64,2.0_real64,3.0_real64,4.0_real64],[2,2])
      identity=reshape([1.0_real64,0.0_real64,0.0_real64,1.0_real64],[2,2])
      call assertEqual(a,matmul(a,identity),tolerance=1.0e-12_real64)
   end subroutine matrix_checks
end module playground_checks

program main
   use FUnit, only: TestSuite, TestMethod, TestRunner, TestResult, SerialContext
   use playground_checks
   implicit none
   type(TestSuite) :: suite
   type(TestRunner) :: runner
   type(TestResult) :: result
   type(SerialContext) :: context
   suite=TestSuite('Playground')
   call suite%addTest(TestMethod('scalar arithmetic',scalar_checks))
   call suite%addTest(TestMethod('vector squares',vector_checks))
   call suite%addTest(TestMethod('matrix identity',matrix_checks))
   runner=TestRunner()
   result=runner%run(suite,context)
   if (.not.result%wasSuccessful()) error stop 'pFUnit checks failed'
   if (result%runCount()/=3 .or. result%failureCount()/=0 .or. result%errorCount()/=0) &
      error stop 'Unexpected test counts'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Verified test cases: ',result%runCount()
   print '(a)', 'PASS pfunit'
end program main

description: RAFFLE 1.0.0 materials-structure library; demonstration checks periodic atom distances in a silicon cell.
source:
! Periodic silicon distances, adapted from RAFFLE's test/test_dist_calcs.f90.
! RAFFLE v1.0.0 is GPL-3.0; original library sources are unchanged.
program main
   use raffle__constants, only: real32
   use raffle__geom_rw, only: basis_type
   use raffle__misc_linalg, only: modu
   use raffle__dist_calcs, only: get_min_dist, get_min_dist_between_point_and_atom
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(basis_type) :: cell
   real(real32) :: point(3), distance, expected, nearest
   integer :: i
   cell%sysname='Silicon'
   cell%nspec=1
   cell%natom=2
   allocate(cell%spec(1))
   cell%spec(1)%num=2
   cell%spec(1)%name='Si'
   allocate(cell%spec(1)%atom(2,3))
   cell%spec(1)%atom(1,:)=[0.0_real32,0.0_real32,0.0_real32]
   cell%spec(1)%atom(2,:)=[0.25_real32,0.25_real32,0.25_real32]
   cell%lat(1,:)=[0.0_real32,2.14_real32,2.14_real32]
   cell%lat(2,:)=[2.14_real32,0.0_real32,2.14_real32]
   cell%lat(3,:)=[2.14_real32,2.14_real32,0.0_real32]
   ! Each point is close to the origin or an equivalent periodic image.
   do i=1,3
      point=real(i,real32)-0.1_real32
      expected=sqrt(3.0_real32)*0.428_real32
      distance=get_min_dist_between_point_and_atom(cell,loc=point,atom=[1,1])
      nearest=modu(get_min_dist(cell,loc=point,lignore_close=.true.))
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(distance) .or. .not.ieee_is_finite(nearest)) error stop 'Nonfinite distance'
      if (abs(distance-expected)>3.0e-6_real32) error stop 'Atom-distance check'
      if (abs(nearest-expected)>3.0e-6_real32) error stop 'Nearest-atom check'
      print '(a,f5.2,a,f12.7)', 'Fractional point (t,t,t), t=',point(1),'; nearest distance: ',nearest
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS raffle'
end program main

gams_procedures.notes: RAFFLE is pinned to release v1.0.0 because current main and v1.1.1 exceed the unchanged 16 MiB archive limit. The native FPM library is unchanged. The checked main adapts test/test_dist_calcs.f90: a two-atom silicon primitive cell and three equivalent fractional points exercise get_min_dist_between_point_and_atom and get_min_dist. Both distances must be finite and agree with sqrt(3)*0.428 within 3e-6 in REAL32. P denotes the demonstrated periodic geometry; no optimization, structure-prediction accuracy, trained model, or full upstream test-suite validation is claimed. GPL-3.0 notices are retained.

source:
! M_history's redo editor, scripted through its optional input unit.
! No shell commands are executed. The history and editing script are scratch files.
program main
   use M_history, only: redo
   implicit none
   ! Use the author's 1024-character example buffer (short buffers are unsupported here).
   character(len=1024) :: line
   integer :: script
   line='temperature = 290'
   call redo(line)
   if (trim(line)/='temperature = 290') error stop 'History changed initial text'
   line='pressure = 1000'
   call redo(line)
   open(newunit=script,status='scratch',action='readwrite',form='formatted')
   write(script,'(a)') 'c/290/300/', ''
   rewind(script)
   line='r 1'
   call redo(line,lun=script)
   if (trim(line)/='temperature = 300') error stop 'Recall/substitution check'
   print '(a)', 'Recalled and edited: '//trim(line)
   close(script)
   open(newunit=script,status='scratch',action='readwrite',form='formatted')
   write(script,'(a)') ''
   rewind(script)
   line='r 2'
   call redo(line,lun=script)
   if (trim(line)/='pressure = 1000') error stop 'Original history was modified'
   print '(a)', 'Original history retained: '//trim(line)
   close(script)
   print '(a)', 'PASS m_history'
end program main

gams_procedures.notes: The unmodified M_history redo editor records two commands in its scratch history file. The self-contained main supplies editing directives through the optional lun argument, recalls line 1, changes 290 to 300 and checks the result, then recalls line 2 and verifies that its original text remains unchanged. No shell command is executed and no interactive terminal is required. The main follows the author application in using a 1024-character buffer. An initial 120-character buffer triggered an upstream bounds error at cin(1:255); that diagnostic is retained separately, and shorter buffers are not verified/supported by this catalog example. N1/N3 cover command input and character editing; no numerical-method classification is inferred. MIT library notices and the public-domain author application notice are retained.

source:
! Offline URL API example, following fortran-curl's examples/url/url.f90 (ISC).
! Parsing and constructing a URL does not make a network request.
program main
   use iso_c_binding, only: c_ptr, c_associated, c_null_ptr
   use curl
   implicit none
   type(c_ptr) :: handle
   character(len=:), allocatable :: host, path, port, query, complete
   integer :: rc
   handle=curl_url()
   if (.not.c_associated(handle)) error stop 'URL allocation failed'
   rc=curl_url_set(handle,CURLUPART_URL,'https://example.org:8443/data/input.csv?sample=1')
   if (rc/=CURLUE_OK) error stop 'URL parsing failed'
   rc=curl_url_get(handle,CURLUPART_HOST,host)
   if (rc/=CURLUE_OK) error stop 'Host extraction failed'
   rc=curl_url_get(handle,CURLUPART_PATH,path)
   if (rc/=CURLUE_OK) error stop 'Path extraction failed'
   rc=curl_url_get(handle,CURLUPART_PORT,port)
   if (rc/=CURLUE_OK) error stop 'Port extraction failed'
   rc=curl_url_get(handle,CURLUPART_QUERY,query)
   if (rc/=CURLUE_OK) error stop 'Query extraction failed'
   if (host/='example.org' .or. path/='/data/input.csv' .or. port/='8443' .or. query/='sample=1') &
      error stop 'Parsed components differ from expected values'
   print '(a)', 'Host: '//host, 'Path: '//path, 'Port: '//port, 'Query: '//query
   rc=curl_url_set(handle,CURLUPART_PATH,'/results/output.csv')
   if (rc/=CURLUE_OK) error stop 'Path update failed'
   rc=curl_url_get(handle,CURLUPART_URL,complete)
   if (rc/=CURLUE_OK) error stop 'URL reconstruction failed'
   if (complete/='https://example.org:8443/results/output.csv?sample=1') error stop 'Reconstructed URL check'
   print '(a)', 'Updated URL: '//complete
   call curl_url_cleanup(handle)
   ! This release uses C cleanup semantics: the caller clears the freed handle.
   handle=c_null_ptr
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortran-curl'
end program main

gams_procedures.notes: Release 0.8.0 is pinned because its documented libcurl minimum is 8.10.0, compatible with the pinned Debian libcurl 8.14.1-2+deb13u7; current main requires 8.20.0. program main
   use plplot, only: plflt, plsdev, plsfnam, plspage, plinit, plenv, pllab, plline, plend, plgver
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=201
   real(plflt) :: x(n), y(n), pi
   integer :: i, unit, bytes, ios
   character(len=80) :: version
   character(len=8) :: signature
   logical :: exists
   pi=acos(-1.0_plflt)
   do i=1,n
      x(i)=-pi+2*pi*real(i-1,plflt)/real(n-1,plflt)
   end do
   y=sin(x)
   if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(y))) error stop 'Nonfinite plot data'
   if (abs(y(51)+1.0_plflt)>1.0e-12_plflt .or. abs(y(151)-1.0_plflt)>1.0e-12_plflt) error stop 'Sine sample check'
   call plgver(version)
   print '(a)', 'PLplot version: '//trim(version)
   call plsdev('pngcairo')
   call plsfnam('plplot-sine.png')
   call plspage(0.0_plflt,0.0_plflt,800,500,0,0)
   call plinit()
   call plenv(-pi,pi,-1.2_plflt,1.2_plflt,0,0)
   call pllab('x (radians)','sin(x)','Sine curve from Fortran with PLplot')
   call plline(x,y)
   call plend()
   inquire(file='plplot-sine.png',exist=exists,size=bytes)
   if (.not.exists .or. bytes<1000) error stop 'PNG not written'
   open(newunit=unit,file='plplot-sine.png',access='stream',form='unformatted',status='old',action='read')
   read(unit,iostat=ios) signature

   print '(a,i0)', 'PNG bytes: ',bytes
   print '(a)', 'PASS plplot'

program command_line_namelist
   ! Adapted from urbanjost/M_CLI example/demo3.f90 (public domain).
   ! Edit the prototype below to experiment with command-line defaults.
   use M_CLI, only: commandline, check_commandline
   implicit none
   integer :: n, ios
   real :: scale, points(3)
   logical :: verbose
   character(len=32) :: title
   character(len=256) :: message
   character(len=:), allocatable :: text
   namelist /args/ n, scale, points, verbose, title

   text = commandline('-n 3 --scale 2.5 --points 1,2,3 --verbose T --title "demo"')
   read(text, nml=args, iostat=ios, iomsg=message)
   call check_commandline(ios, message)
   if (ios /= 0) error stop 'NAMELIST conversion failed'
   if (n /= 3 .or. abs(scale-2.5) > 1.e-6) error stop 'numeric options'
   if (any(abs(points-[1.,2.,3.]) > 1.e-6)) error stop 'array option'
   if (.not. verbose .or. title /= 'demo') error stop 'logical/string options'

   write(*, nml=args)
   print '(a,f8.3)', 'Scaled sum of points: ', scale*sum(points)
   print '(a)', 'PASS m_cli'

description: Fortran bindings to libmodbus; offline floating-point/register conversions in four byte orders. No device connection is required by the example.
source:
program register_conversions
   ! Offline libmodbus operations: no connection or physical device is needed.
   use modbus, only: c_float, c_uint16_t, modbus_set_float_abcd, modbus_get_float_abcd, &
      modbus_set_float_badc, modbus_get_float_badc, modbus_set_float_cdab, &
      modbus_get_float_cdab, modbus_set_float_dcba, modbus_get_float_dcba
   implicit none
   integer(c_uint16_t) :: registers(2)
   real(c_float), parameter :: values(4) = &
      [12.5_c_float, -3.25_c_float, 0.0_c_float, 123.456_c_float]
   real(c_float) :: restored
   integer :: i

   print '(a)', '32-bit floating-point values stored in two 16-bit registers:'
   do i = 1, size(values)
      call modbus_set_float_abcd(values(i), registers)
      restored = modbus_get_float_abcd(registers)
      call check('ABCD', values(i), restored, registers)
      call modbus_set_float_badc(values(i), registers)
      restored = modbus_get_float_badc(registers)
      call check('BADC', values(i), restored, registers)
      call modbus_set_float_cdab(values(i), registers)
      restored = modbus_get_float_cdab(registers)
      call check('CDAB', values(i), restored, registers)
      call modbus_set_float_dcba(values(i), registers)
      restored = modbus_get_float_dcba(registers)
      call check('DCBA', values(i), restored, registers)
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortran-modbus'
contains
   subroutine check(order, original, actual, words)
      character(len=*), intent(in) :: order
      real(c_float), intent(in) :: original, actual
      integer(c_uint16_t), intent(in) :: words(2)
      if (actual /= original) error stop 'register conversion round trip'
      print '(a,1x,f8.3,2(1x,z4.4),a,f8.3)', order, original, words, ' -> ', actual
   end subroutine check
end program register_conversions

gams_procedures.procedure: modbus_set_float_abcd / modbus_get_float_abcd / BADC / CDAB / DCBA variants
gams_procedures.notes: The original Fortran 2018 FPM bindings are compiled against pinned Debian libmodbus 3.1.11-2. The consumer checks positive, negative and zero single-precision values through the ABCD, BADC, CDAB and DCBA register conversion APIs and prints register words in hexadecimal. These are offline operations, with no socket, serial port or Modbus device. N2 covers bit/byte representation; the catalog does not claim verified device communication. The author test/test_modbus.f90 documents context use but is not used as a device test. ISC notices are retained.

! Cairo drawing adapted from gtk-fortran examples/cairo-basics.f90.
! Copyright (C) 2011 The gtk-fortran team (Jerry DeLisle and Vincent Magnin).
! GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1; see the upstream LICENSE files.
program headless_cairo
   use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding, only: c_ptr, c_associated, c_int, c_double, c_null_char
   use gtk, only: CAIRO_FORMAT_ARGB32, CAIRO_FONT_SLANT_NORMAL, CAIRO_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL
   use cairo, only: cairo_image_surface_create, cairo_create, cairo_surface_status, &
      cairo_status, cairo_set_source_rgb, cairo_paint, cairo_set_line_width, &
      cairo_move_to, cairo_curve_to, cairo_stroke, cairo_arc, cairo_select_font_face, &
      cairo_set_font_size, cairo_show_text, cairo_surface_write_to_png, &
      cairo_destroy, cairo_surface_destroy
   implicit none
   type(c_ptr) :: surface, cr
   integer(c_int) :: status
   integer :: i, unit, bytes
   logical :: exists
   character(len=8) :: signature
   real(c_double), parameter :: pi = acos(-1.0_c_double)
   character(len=*), parameter :: filename = 'gtk-fortran-cairo.png'

   ! An image surface requires neither gtk_init() nor a display server.
   surface = cairo_image_surface_create(CAIRO_FORMAT_ARGB32, 640_c_int, 400_c_int)
   if (.not. c_associated(surface)) error stop 'null surface'
   if (cairo_surface_status(surface) /= 0) error stop 'image surface creation'
   cr = cairo_create(surface)
   if (.not. c_associated(cr)) error stop 'null drawing context'
   if (cairo_status(cr) /= 0) error stop 'drawing context creation'
   call cairo_set_source_rgb(cr, 1.0_c_double, 1.0_c_double, 1.0_c_double)
   call cairo_paint(cr)

   call cairo_set_source_rgb(cr, 0.12_c_double, 0.28_c_double, 0.65_c_double)
   call cairo_set_line_width(cr, 4.0_c_double)
   call cairo_move_to(cr, 40.0_c_double, 310.0_c_double)
   call cairo_curve_to(cr, 160.0_c_double, 20.0_c_double, 430.0_c_double, &
      490.0_c_double, 600.0_c_double, 110.0_c_double)
   call cairo_stroke(cr)

   do i = 0, 4
      call cairo_set_source_rgb(cr, 0.85_c_double, 0.15_c_double+i*0.10_c_double, 0.12_c_double)
      call cairo_arc(cr, 130.0_c_double+95.0_c_double*i, 220.0_c_double, &
         24.0_c_double+3.0_c_double*i, 0.0_c_double, 2*pi)
      call cairo_stroke(cr)
   end do

   call cairo_set_source_rgb(cr, 0.12_c_double, 0.12_c_double, 0.12_c_double)
   call cairo_select_font_face(cr, 'Sans'//c_null_char, &
      CAIRO_FONT_SLANT_NORMAL, CAIRO_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL)
   call cairo_set_font_size(cr, 28.0_c_double)
   call cairo_move_to(cr, 40.0_c_double, 55.0_c_double)
   call cairo_show_text(cr, 'gtk-fortran: Cairo without a window'//c_null_char)
   if (cairo_status(cr) /= 0) error stop 'drawing failed'
   status = cairo_surface_write_to_png(surface, filename//c_null_char)
   call cairo_destroy(cr)
   call cairo_surface_destroy(surface)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'PNG write failed'
   inquire(file=filename, exist=exists, size=bytes)
   if (.not. exists .or. bytes < 1000) error stop 'PNG missing or too small'
   open(newunit=unit, file=filename, access='stream', form='unformatted', status='old')
   read(unit) signature
   close(unit)
   if (signature /= achar(137)//'PNG'//achar(13)//achar(10)//achar(26)//achar(10)) &
      error stop 'PNG signature'
   print '(a,i0)', 'PNG bytes: ', bytes
   print '(a)', 'PASS gtk-fortran'
end program headless_cairo

! Adapted from FyCollections integer/string list examples (BSD-2-Clause).
program typed_lists
   use type_intlist, only: IntList, IntList_init, int_size => size
   use type_stringlist, only: StringList, StringList_init, string_size => size
   implicit none
   type(IntList), allocatable :: numbers
   type(StringList), allocatable :: words
   integer :: i

   allocate(numbers, words)
   call IntList_init(numbers)
   call StringList_init(words)
   do i = 1, 3
      call numbers%append(i)
   end do
   call numbers%insert(2, -1)
   if (int_size(numbers) /= 4) error stop 'integer list size'
   if (any([(numbers%get(i), i=1,4)] /= [1,-1,2,3])) error stop 'integer list contents'
   if (numbers%find(2) /= 3 .or. numbers%find(99) /= 0) error stop 'integer search'
   print '(a,4(i0,1x))', 'Integer list: ', (numbers%get(i), i=1,int_size(numbers))
   call numbers%delete(2)
   if (int_size(numbers) /= 3) error stop 'integer deletion size'
   if (any([(numbers%get(i), i=1,3)] /= [1,2,3])) error stop 'integer deletion contents'

   call words%append('one')
   call words%append('two')
   call words%append('three')
   call words%insert(2, 'five')
   if (string_size(words) /= 4) error stop 'string list size'
   if (words%get(1) /= 'one' .or. words%get(2) /= 'five' .or. &
       words%get(3) /= 'two' .or. words%get(4) /= 'three') error stop 'string list contents'
   if (words%find('two') /= 3 .or. words%find('missing') /= 0) error stop 'string search'
   print '(a)', 'String list:'
   do i = 1, string_size(words)
      print '(2x,i0,2a)', i, ': ', words%get(i)
   end do
   deallocate(numbers, words)
   print '(a)', 'PASS fycollections'
end program typed_lists

Six generated Fortran files, checksums of all template/license inputs, and xgenerate_fycollections.py retain a reproducible recipe. The package supplies the author IntList and StringList specializations, not automatic runtime generation for arbitrary user types. Its operator FPM wrapper uses version 0.0.0 to identify no inferred upstream release; the source is pinned by commit. The checked main adapts the author integer/string list examples and checks append, insertion, retrieval, successful/missing searches, integer deletion and allocatable-list finalization. N4/N5 cover storage containers and searching. Pointer/array list specializations and the complete upstream tests are not verified. BSD-2-Clause notices are retained.

description: SDL2 bindings; the checked example draws colored bars on a software surface and saves/reloads a browser-viewable PNG without a window.
source:
! Headless software surfaces: no window, display server or event loop.
program headless_sdl
   use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding, only: c_f_pointer, c_int32_t, c_int64_t, c_int, c_char, c_null_char
   use sdl2, only: sdl_surface, sdl_pixel_format, sdl_rect, sdl_init, sdl_quit, &
      sdl_create_rgb_surface, sdl_fill_rect, sdl_map_rgb, sdl_free_surface
   use sdl2_image, only: img_init, IMG_INIT_PNG, img_load, img_quit
   implicit none
   type(sdl_surface), pointer :: surface, loaded
   type(sdl_pixel_format), pointer :: format
   type(sdl_rect) :: rectangle
   integer(c_int32_t), pointer :: pixels(:)
   integer(c_int32_t) :: colors(3)
   integer :: status, i, unit, bytes
   logical :: exists
   character(len=8) :: signature
   character(len=*), parameter :: filename = 'fortran-sdl2-bars.png'

   ! The pinned Fortran bindings provide IMG_Load but omit IMG_SavePNG.
   ! This standard C interface supplies only the missing PNG-save declaration.
   interface
      function save_png(image, name) bind(c, name='IMG_SavePNG') result(rc)
         import :: sdl_surface, c_char, c_int
         type(sdl_surface), intent(in) :: image
         character(kind=c_char), intent(in) :: name(*)
         integer(c_int) :: rc
      end function save_png
   end interface

   if (sdl_init(0) /= 0) error stop 'SDL initialization'
   if (iand(img_init(IMG_INIT_PNG), IMG_INIT_PNG) == 0) error stop 'PNG initialization'
   surface => sdl_create_rgb_surface(0, 640, 360, 32, &
      int(z'00FF0000',c_int64_t), int(z'0000FF00',c_int64_t), &
      int(z'000000FF',c_int64_t), 0_c_int64_t)
   if (.not. associated(surface)) error stop 'surface allocation'
   call c_f_pointer(surface%format, format)
   rectangle = sdl_rect(0, 0, surface%w, surface%h)
   status = sdl_fill_rect(surface, rectangle, sdl_map_rgb(format, 245, 245, 245))
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'background fill'
   colors = [sdl_map_rgb(format, 35, 95, 195), sdl_map_rgb(format, 210, 65, 50), &
             sdl_map_rgb(format, 35, 155, 100)]
   do i = 1, 3
      rectangle = sdl_rect(40+200*(i-1), 40+70*(i-1), 160, 280-70*(i-1))
      status = sdl_fill_rect(surface, rectangle, colors(i))
      if (status /= 0) error stop 'rectangle fill'
   end do
   call c_f_pointer(surface%pixels, pixels, [surface%pitch*surface%h/4])
   if (pixels(1) /= sdl_map_rgb(format, 245, 245, 245)) error stop 'background pixel'
   do i = 1, 3
      if (pixels(300*(surface%pitch/4)+120+200*(i-1)+1) /= colors(i)) &
         error stop 'bar color'
   end do
   nullify(pixels, format)
   status = save_png(surface, filename//c_null_char)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'PNG save'
   call sdl_free_surface(surface)
   nullify(surface)

   ! Load the PNG through the package API and check its dimensions.
   loaded => img_load(filename//c_null_char)
   if (.not. associated(loaded)) error stop 'PNG reload'
   if (loaded%w /= 640 .or. loaded%h /= 360) error stop 'image dimensions'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Reloaded PNG: ', loaded%w, ' x ', loaded%h
   call sdl_free_surface(loaded)
   nullify(loaded)
   call img_quit()
   call sdl_quit()

   inquire(file=filename, exist=exists, size=bytes)
   if (.not. exists .or. bytes < 500) error stop 'PNG missing or too small'
   open(newunit=unit, file=filename, access='stream', form='unformatted', status='old')
   read(unit) signature
   close(unit)
   if (signature /= achar(137)//'PNG'//achar(13)//achar(10)//achar(26)//achar(10)) &
      error stop 'PNG signature'
   print '(a,i0)', 'PNG bytes: ', bytes
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortran-sdl2'
end program headless_sdl

gams_procedures.notes: The original FPM library and Fortran bindings are unchanged. The image pins SDL 2.32.4, SDL2_image 2.8.8, SDL2_mixer 2.8.1, SDL2_ttf 2.24.0 and GL/GLU development libraries; native link flags are recorded in the catalog build environment. The checked main creates a 640x360 32-bit software surface, fills a background and three bars, checks source pixels, saves a PNG, reloads it through the package IMG_Load API, and checks dimensions plus the file signature/size. The pinned bindings omit IMG_SavePNG, so the main includes only that standard C function declaration. No image encoder or drawing algorithm is substituted for SDL. No video subsystem, window, display server, hardware renderer, audio device or event loop is needed. The returned browser preview is visually reviewed. Q covers graphics. Interactive rendering, audio, fonts and OpenGL/GLU routines are compiled/linked facilities but not runtime-verified by this consumer. ISC notices are retained.
